newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo forex trading volume hits record high in May.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo forex trading volume hits record high in May.

text.p: The monthly volume of dollar/yen spot and swap transactions on the Tokyo foreign exchange market hit a record high in May, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) said on Tuesday.
Dollar/yen rates fluctuated widely in May.
According to figures compiled by the BOJ, the overall volume of dollar-for-yen spot and swap transactions through brokers rose to $638.31 billion.
The volume of spot dollar/yen transactions through brokers hit a record high of around $326.34 billion.
The daily average volume of overall spot and swap transactions rose above $30 billion in May for the first time in any month.
The dollar rose to 127.47 yen on May 1, its highest level since August 1992, but lost more than 15 yen in less than three weeks, dipping as low as 111.98 yen on May 20.
